newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures trade swells in rising mkt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures trade swells in rising mkt.

text.p: Greater volume returned to Australian wheat futures trading on Friday in a rising market.
A total of 34 contracts changed hands with March 1997 rising by A$2.50 a tonne to A$177.00 and May 1997 adding A$3.00 to A$177.00.
Chris Gray of C,A & L Bell Commodities Pty Ltd, which handled all the May sales, said liquidity remained so low that the market was being "pushed around".
Main forces behind the market were the Australian Wheat Board pool, while the cash market also had some influence.
Gray saw no fundamental reason for the uptrend.
The stronger Australian market followed a strong rise in Chicago overnight, on a surge in soybeans and a rally in corn.
